Black and white DARKROOM

Our B&W darkroom, located in heart of Manhattan, is equipped for all of your developing and printing needs.

*Penumbra facilities are available to be rented by MEMBERS ONLY.

Not a member? Become one today!

WHAT’S INCLUDED?

  • 4 B&W Enlargers - Ilford Multigrade Heads (35mm through 4x5) on Beseler 45V-XL chassis.

  • Easels, trays, grain focusers, timers, and safelights.

  • Stainless steel sink with temperature controlled water filtration.

  • Drying racks and film drying cabinet with fan & heater.

  • Basic chemistry (we use Ilford but feel free to bring your own), Photo-Flo, Perma-Wash, etc.

  • Paterson and stainless steel tanks for developing 35mm and 120 film. Stearman Press SP-445 Compact for 4x5.

    • Other tanks, developing equipment, and chemistry available upon request.

*Paper is NOT included.

RESERVE YOUR SPOT!

  • Rental is for the entire space, but feel free to bring a friend or two to print with. They must also be member!

  • 4 people are allowed to print at once.

  • Max print 11x14 (larger easles and trays upon request).

  • Half Day (any block of 4 hours) and Full Day (8 hours) options

  • To rent the scanner for the full day, please select both 10AM and 2PM slots
If you have any questions about renting our facilities, please reach out to info@penumbrafoundation.org
